errors: Assumed Mon-Fri all hours valid for every symbol
Incorrectly treated EUR crosses (EURGBP/EURJPY/EURCHF) as Sun-20:00 open / Thu-19:00 close (they are actually Mon 00:00 - Fri 19:00)

us_holiday_policy.description: US-only holidays (Memorial Day, Labor Day, July 4, Thanksgiving) are NOT automatically treated as full FX closures.
us_holiday_policy.evidence: Observed continuous trading on US holidays across all 10 pairs; no provider-wide full-day closure on those dates unless corroborated by data.
us_holiday_policy.action: Only hours the provider is demonstrably closed are excluded; holidays are reported separately when an actual closure is observed.
